import numpy as np

def attention_forward(Q, K, V):
    d = Q.shape[1]
    S = Q @ K.T / np.sqrt(d)
    max_S = np.max(S, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    exp_S = np.exp(S - max_S)
    sum_exp_S = np.sum(exp_S, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    P = exp_S / sum_exp_S
    out = P @ V
    cache = (Q, K, V, P, S, max_S, exp_S, sum_exp_S, d)
    return out, cache

def attention_backward(dout, cache):
    Q, K, V, P, S, max_S, exp_S, sum_exp_S, d = cache
    T = Q.shape[0]

    dV = P.T @ dout

    dP = dout @ V.T
    dS = P * (dP - np.sum(dP * P, axis=1, keepdims=True))

    dK = (Q / np.sqrt(d)) @ dS
    dQ = (K / np.sqrt(d)) @ dS.T

    return dQ, dK, dV
